device_description: The Mothbox is an open-source nocturnal insect monitoring device. It is designed to be low-cost, small, and lightweight, and although it can be used anywhere, it was designed for tropical field biologists who are working in remote locations. The Mothbox is typically powered by a lithium battery so that it can be used without a power grid, but it can be plugged in to constant power, attached to a solar panel, or use another type of battery. Anyone can make their own Mothbox - find out how by going to mothbox.org!

power_autonomy_continuous: This depends on your usage, but the way we typically program it & using the TalentCell battery we recommend, the Mothbox operates for 3 nights before needing recharging.

maintenance_interval: Target felt may need to be cleaned once a month, depending on use. Lens should be cleaned as needed. Battery charge when needed, unless connected to grid or solar (every 3 days the way we usually program it). USB should be backed up and cleared about once a month with a 128 GB drive.
